reviews.review_title: SHEIN offers a huge variety of trendy…
reviews.review_text: SHEIN offers a huge variety of trendy clothing at affordable prices, and it's easy to find something that fits your style. However, the quality is inconsistent-some items are great, while others don't match the photos or size guide.

I would give SHIEN a 3 1/2 if I could. Their clothing is a hit or miss when it comes to quality and size. However, I do appreciate the fact they have a stress free return policy. Even though the return process can be cumbersome, ,I had an issue returning an item using their return label. I contacted customer service via their live chat and provided them with proof . They then were able to provide me with a full refund and did not require me to return the item.  I did not like the fit or quality they made things right with me. I’ll shop SHIEN before I do fashion Nova which has a horrible return policy and inconsistent sizing .Thanks SHIEN for at least trying to do right.

reviews.review_title: I returned the item(s) according to…
reviews.review_text:
Business Commitment: Delivery of ordered items, including the right to return items and receive a full refund in accordance with the merchant’s official return policy.

Nature of Dispute and Description of the Issue:

On 24/05/2026, I submitted an official return request within the timeframe permitted by SHEIN's policy. The merchant issued a return request and a pickup label via their designated courier company, HFD 

The package was prepared for pickup on time; however, the courier service acting on behalf of the merchant failed to arrive and never collected the package. As a result, the items remain in my possession.

Attempts to Resolve with the Merchant:

I repeatedly contacted SHEIN's customer support to request a rescheduled pickup or an alternative return label. The merchant refused to provide a solution, disclaimed responsibility for the courier’s failure, and insisted that a refund can only be issued once the items arrive at their warehouse—a condition made impossible solely due to their own courier’s failure. Subsequently, customer support ceased responding, stalled without offering any resolution, and ultimately blocked me from accessing their support channels entirely.

Summary:

I have exhausted all attempts to resolve this directly with the merchant. This constitutes a clear non-delivery/failure of service (loss of return rights guaranteed by contract). I request a chargeback / full refund for this transaction.
